history.terminal: one existing ActivityFailed or ActivityTimedOut outcome for the real attempt; matching retry_disposition; no retry task, following attempt/start or ActivityRetryScheduled

history.interruption: retain local_recovery and the engine RuntimeException provenance; scheduled uses the existing cold-replay retry reason; terminal uses ActivityFailed, except that an actually due timeout retains engine_timeout precedence
history.recovery_replay: consume the stored recovery decision and original unknown stop state without current clock/policy/physical-state substitution; no callback is invoked by recovery
